geometry.note: 'Verified' because the coordinate is surveyed and published in an official project document (the laboratory's external emergency plan), independent of any OpenStreetMap check. The coordinate is given to 0.01 arcsecond in the source (implying sub-metre nominal precision); accuracy is nonetheless set to 30 m, a conservative figure for a government-published DMS coordinate of unstated survey method.
geometry.quote: Il Centro direzionale e i Laboratori Esterni sono localizzati dalle coordinate: 42°25'13.56"N – 13°30'59.33"E (WGS 84)

name: LNGS Centro Direzionale / External Laboratories (surveyed point)
notes: This point is 79.6 m from the vertex-averaged centroid of the independently-georeferenced OSM building geometry:lngs-external-labs-boundary, corroborating both.

This is the surface administrative complex, not the underground halls: it is at the surface, several kilometres from the halls by tunnel, so it does not locate Halls A, B or C. See the Hall A, B and C records for the underground position.

summary.plain: The government-surveyed location of LNGS's surface offices and support buildings at Assergi, from the laboratory's official external emergency plan.
